text:
maria: heads up — i'm running a small experiment for a rate-aware batcher shape. goal: reduce cost for steady low-qps tenants while preserving p99 for spikes. sketch below.

sam: what do you mean by rate-aware? how is it different from cohort batching?

maria: instead of static window shapes we observe per-tenant input-rate over a short horizon and pick one of {micro, default, pack} shaping profiles. we also add a circuit-breaker to avoid overpacking during spikes.

devon: curious about the circuit-breaker contract. do you mean hard-evict or fallback to low-latency pool?

maria: fallback to a dedicated single-shot pool + drop-in timeout. rough config: 

```
batcher:
  horizon_ms: 200
  profiles:
    micro: max_wait_ms: 12, target_size: 1-4
    default: max_wait_ms: 40, target_size: 8-32
    pack: max_wait_ms: 120, target_size: 64-256
  circuit_breaker:
    spike_threshold_rps: 10
    fallback_pool: low-latency
    soft_cap_per_tenant: 16
```

sam: neat. telemetry items?

maria: per-tenant profile choice, avg wait, p50/p95/p99 latency, overpack_count, cb_trips, fallback_routed, cost_per_token.

zane: +1 to tracking overpack_count and cb_trips. also ensure TTL on profile so we don't oscillate (hysteresis).

devon: can we make admission signal additive so routing can be incremental? e.g., "prefer_pack" score instead of binary.

maria: yep thinking that. prefer_score in [-1..1] used by router; thresholding only at pack boundary. reduces flip-flopping.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary batcher/shape v1 at 2024-07-15 15:00 UTC :rocket:

sam: next steps: run on 10% tenants for 48h, compare latency tail and cost. create an eval set with synthetic bursts + steady streams.

maria: i'll open an experiment doc and a PR with telemetry dashboards. tagging @devon @zane for API contract review. :thumbsup:

devon: lgtm but add explicit SLA fallback: if p99 > SLA for 3 consecutive 1m windows, bypass profile and route to low-latency pool.

zane: also add invariant: no tenant can be packed beyond soft_cap_per_tenant without explicit opt-in.

maria: noted. thanks all.
